Title: Invalid email format accepted during registration
Steps to Reproduce: Enter user@test and submit registration form
Expected Result: Email validation should reject invalid format
Actual Result: System allows invalid email in some cases
Recommended Fix: Add strict email regex validation on client and server side

Title: Invalid email accepted before reset request
Steps to Reproduce: Enter abc@ and submit forgot password form
Expected Result: System should show invalid email error
Recommended Fix: Validate email before sending reset request

Title: Submit button overlaps footer text on small screens
Expected Result: Button should remain separated and visible
Recommended Fix: Adjust spacing, button container, and responsive CSS

Title: Login error message disappears too quickly
Expected Result: Error message should remain visible until user edits input
Recommended Fix: Keep message persistent until user action

Title: Password toggle icon missing accessible label
Expected Result: Screen reader label should be present
Recommended Fix: Add aria-label to password toggle button
